title: Closed-loop poles of 1/(s(s + 2)) as K grows
caption: For K ≤ 1 the poles −1 ± √(1 − K) are real and move together; they meet at −1 when K = 1 (critical damping). Beyond K = 1 they are complex with real part −1.
alt: Real parts of the two poles against K: two branches from 0 and −2 meeting at −1 when K = 1, then a single line at −1 for K above 1.
description: The characteristic equation is s² + 2s + K = 0, with poles −1 ± √(1 − K).
At K = 0 they are 0 and −2; as K grows they approach each other.
At K = 1 they meet at −1: critical damping. For K > 1 they are −1 ± i√(K − 1), real part −1.

checks.name: the poles meet at −1 when K = 1
